card.name: Partway through numbers, dates and names
card.fires_on: Fires on a word piece or space right before a number or date continues, such as an ordinal ending, a month name, or a space before a digit. Also seen inside a long drug name just before its next word.

modes.label: Before a number or date
modes.description: The marked piece sits just ahead of digits in a date, edition, or index number.

modes.label: Inside a long name
modes.description: The marked piece is the end of a drug or foreign word, with more text to follow.
